##### Project general facts 

Square X Residencies, meticulously crafted by Tasmeer Indigo Properties, stands as a testament to elegance, sophisticationand modernity. More than just a collection of exquisite apartments, this development is a lifestyle destination where every aspect of modern living is catered to with utmost care and attention. From the thoughtfully designed residences to the world-class amenities, Square X Residencies offers a vibrant and fulfilling lifestyle for everyone in the community.

Residents enjoy a diverse array of activities and facilities that promote health, well-being, and socialization, including infinity pools, fitness centers, lush landscaped gardens, and dedicated maintenance services. Every detail is designed to ensure a vibrant and fulfilling lifestyle, creating a community where residents can thrive, connect, and unwind.

Every residence at Square X Residencies features modern finishing with high-quality materials and is equipped with premium branded appliances from Bosch, Grohe, Geberit, Villeroy & Boch, Apple Home, and Nespresso. The interiors are designed with contemporary elegance, offering a seamless blend of luxury and functionality that reflects the developer's commitment to excellence.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in the heart of Jumeirah Village Circle, a vibrant and rapidly growing community that captivates residents and visitors alike, this exceptional location offers a harmonious blend of modern living and natural beauty. The idyllic circular-shaped neighborhood features tree-lined streets, tranquil parks, and spacious villas and apartments, creating a truly unique and welcoming place to call home.

The location is distinguished by its sense of peace and balance, providing a welcome escape from the hustle and bustle of city life while still being conveniently located within Dubai. Residents enjoy a host of amenities, including schools, shopping centers, parks, and recreational facilities, all thoughtfully integrated into the community's design. It is a place where families thrive, professionals find a convenient home, and nature lovers revel in the serene surroundings.

For those seeking a residence that embodies modern luxury, community connection, and a prime Dubai address, Jumeirah Village Circle delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of tree-lined streets, tranquil parks, and strategic connectivity makes it one of Dubai's most desirable destinations. This is a place where one can enjoy the best of city living — serene, connected and effortlessly refined.
